['Schwarz-Gruppe '].company_description: The Schwarz-Gruppe, headed by Dieter Schwarz, is a German retail group that operates the Kaufland and Lidl discount supermarkets. With revenue of over $140 billion, the Schwarz-Gruppe is one of the most successful business enterprises in Europe. The group has over 575,000 employees and has been steadily growing its revenue in recent years. The Schwarz-Gruppe is also involved in investing in artificial intelligence technology in Germany.

['Mercedes-Benz Group AG '].company_description: The Mercedes-Benz Group AG, formerly known as Daimler AG, is a German multinational automotive corporation. It is one of the world's leading car manufacturers and is headquartered in Stuttgart, Germany. The company operates in the automotive industry and offers a range of products under the Mercedes-Benz brand, including cars, vans (including Mercedes-AMG and Mercedes-Maybach), and Smart vehicles. It also has shares in other vehicle manufacturers such as Daimler Truck, Denza, BAIC Motor, and Aston Martin. The Mercedes-Benz Group is known for its luxury and high-performance vehicles and is a major player in the global automotive market.
